title: AgentResult
description: Result of a single agent execution dispatched by the agent runner

runId.description: Unique identifier for this run instance

taskId.description: Identifier of the task that was executed

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent that was executed

output.description: Output produced by the agent, or null if execution failed

error.description: Error message if execution failed, otherwise null

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution started

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution completed

durationMs.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds from start to completion
